item.title: We Need More Women in Senior Leadership: Closing Hospitality’s Gender Gap
item.description: More than half of the hospitality workforce are women, yet they remain hugely underrepresented in leadership roles. To fix the gender equity gap in our industry, we need systemic change. The hospitality industry runs on talent, creativity, and care, and globally, women provide more than half of it. They make up over 50% of the hospitality and F&B workforce. Yet despite being the majority to help power the industry, women are significantly underrepresented in leadership and decision-making roles.
